column1: # Plan C - Raspberry Pi 4. Second-microarchitecture confirmation for ARM.
# Breadth of radix coverage is Graviton's job (Plan D, all 598 sets uncapped).
# This box spends its budget on DIMENSIONS at a modest cap instead, because
# all 34 distinct leading radices and both trailing DFT radices (16, 32) are
# already reachable at a 4M cap - beyond that, longer FFTs only chain more
# radix-16/32 passes through the same macros. See PLAN-PI.md.
# scalar oracle: isolates ARM-SIMD from ARM-general, and must be bit-identical
# to the x86 boxes' nosimd sweeps
# aarch64 + clang on cortex-a72 codegen (#234 was aarch64 + clang-14 + -flto)
